definitions.explanation: A young plant grown from seed, ready to be transplanted.

examples.japanese: トマトの{苗|なえ}を{買|か}った。
{苗|なえ}を{畑|はたけ}に{植|う}える。
examples.english: To plant seedlings in the field.

examples.japanese: {稲|いね}の{苗|なえ}を{田|た}んぼに{植|う}える。
examples.english: To plant rice seedlings in the paddy.

notes:
{苗|なえ} refers to a seedling or young plant.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {苗木|なえぎ}: sapling, young tree
- {苗床|なえどこ}: seedbed
- {野菜|やさい}の{苗|なえ}: vegetable seedlings

AGRICULTURE:
{稲|いね}の{苗|なえ} (rice seedlings) are important in Japanese rice cultivation.
